- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/488_P37.60__visual-regression-and-operator-gallery.md`
  (manifest row 488, Round 11, P37, 11D; catalog `R11-K13-UXK14-10`; depends
  P35.51 + P36.16; gate `none`; OM-20 n/a; live stage/legs `none`)
- **Base:** `r11/P37.59-intake-operation-dark` (`f3151dbd`)
- **Config:** `implement-spec … live_verification=false` — engineering
  dispatch. The operator gallery is `prepared_not_executed` review
  material; K14 §7's "beautiful" sign-off stays the operator's — nothing
  here approves or simulates approval.
- **Requirement stamps:** **SIG-UI-152** (owner) · DR-K14-13 / SIG-UI-147
  (dark project) · DR-K14-15 / SIG-UI-149 (reduced-motion project) ·

## What this changes

- **The visual-regression grid** (`web/playwright.visual.config.ts` +
  `web/tests/visual/`): coverage is DERIVED — `sig.page-types-manifest/1`
  now records each emitted route's `component` (page module) and
  `dataSource`; `templates.ts` claims every module into a template group;
  each group shoots a deterministic representative at every
  `{light,dark} × {1440,390,320}` cell with canvases masked and
  `maxDiffPixelRatio 0.01`. An unclaimed module or unresolved group fails
  loud; a mis-wired (non-national) build fails the `dataSource` guard AND
  every shot skips, so real names can never render into a baseline.
- **Baseline provenance** (`tests/visual/baselines.json`,
  `sig.visual-baselines/1`): every committed snapshot cites its ticket;
  `scripts/visual-adopt-baselines.mjs --ticket …` is the only adoption path
  (the flag is required). The committed set — **558 cells, all citing
  P37.60** — was minted on linux/arm64 in the pinned
  `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble` container over the
  synthetic national build via the same `-actual.png` → adopt path the CI
  artifact feeds; an in-container verify run then passed **582/582**. If
  the amd64 runner ever exceeds the bound, the `visual-grid-actuals`
  artifact + `--ticket` adoption is the recorded recovery.
- **Determinism fix** (`visual.spec.ts`): the vendored variable font is
  `font-display: optional` — a shipped CLS choice, but the
  webfont-vs-fallback decision is taken per first paint, so under load the
  same page rendered different metrics run-to-run (37/582 flaky cells;
  fallback `<strong>` never synthesised). The spec route-intercepts
  stylesheets and rewrites `optional → swap` for the grid only — the
  shipped CSS is untouched and every cell renders the webfont canonically
  (`toHaveScreenshot` already waits on `document.fonts`).
- **The `dark` Playwright project** (`tests/e2e/dark.spec.ts`): every
  template representative — declared `color-scheme`, real dark background
  luminance, axe WCAG 2.2 AA in dark, and `@media print` forcing light.
  It caught a real bug on first sweep: `.sig-explore-picker__btn` took the
  UA dark `buttonface` and the muted count failed AA → now painted with
  token surfaces.
- **The `reduced-motion` project** (`tests/e2e/reduced-motion.spec.ts` +
  `web/src/lib/motion.ts`): zero-duration transition/animation sweep on
  every representative, post-interaction T2 checks, and the camera guard —
  every `easeTo`/`fitBounds` in `MapApp.tsx` routes through
  `easeOrJumpTo`/`fitBoundsOrJump` (`jumpTo` / `cameraForBounds`+`jumpTo`
  under reduce); `motion-guard.test.ts` bans bare call sites so no future
  camera move can bypass it.
- **The operator gallery** (`scripts/visual-gallery.mjs`): a self-contained
  baseline/actual/diff review page written under
  `docs/build/logs/visual-gallery/` — the gitignored, never-published
  subtree; refuses `dist`/`public` targets; prints the operator checklist,
  signs off nothing.
- **CI wiring**: `national_budget_leg.sh` gains `visual` + `gallery`
  subcommands (`check:visual`/`gallery:visual` npm aliases); the `web` job
  runs the grid over the national build, uploads actuals on failure and the
  gallery artifact always. `check:perf:national` (`all`) runs the same
  extended leg.
